title: Skal's Admins Essentials
description: Skal's Admins Essentials add a creative gun (For Now).
body:
## Skal's Admins Essentials

Skal's Admins Essentials is a litle plugin and a small project that add litles game additions. For exemple : a simple creative shotgun (The shot gun is a sniffer egg).

<details><summary>Features</summary>
  • Creative-gun Only for the admins (to have fun with players).
</details>

<details><summary>Changelog</summary>
  • 1.0.0 - Added Creative-gun.
</details>

**You need to install this texture pack too : [TexturePack](https://modrinth.com/project/skals-admins-essentials-texturepack)**

If you have **ANY** issue. Go in my issue tracker : **[Skal's Discord Server](https://discord.gg/YJmgjB3Wyb)**

_Made by Skal/Diablot/Skaleur (All Same Person)_
